title: Momoi Airi — That's So Unfair!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!

rows.Line: One week after the Summer Festival
Diner

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmm... This roasted tea parfait is so good! Don't knock it before you try it just because it's a diner, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree!
I'll try mine now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the syrup on this warabimochi parfait goes so well with the sweet soybean powder that it came with.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Hey, both of you, mind sharing a little since we have some extra plates?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, be my guest!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for tagging along with me, Ena, Shizuku! I'm glad we got to try so many Japanese-styled desserts!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm just glad I got to hang out with you two. That was a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Even though we bumped into each other during the festival, it sort of has been a while since we hung out together like this, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Um, Ena?
About Mizuki... How have things been since, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'd like to know too...
You two looked like you were having quite a bit of fun during the festival.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure I can say there's been much progress...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for not being able to help you out much, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm also sorry...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, you two have nothing to apologize for!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Like we discussed before, I know that this might take a very, very long time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you've both already been a huge help just by listening to what's going on between me and Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you sure? In that case, I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We may not be out of the woods yet, but Mizuki has shown some signs of seemingly feeling better...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, really?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes. I think this other girl in our group said something and ended up having a positive effect...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That taught me that I can cheer Mizuki up by just talking about whatever's going on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everything I did sort of felt futile at first, but now I know that's not actually the case anymore.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Yeah, the difference between knowing and not knowing that is pretty huge.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As much as I was worried about Mizuki, I was getting concerned over how hard Ena had to try. I'm glad she's been able to make some progress.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, Ena, what are the other people in your group like?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, the others? Well, you already know me, the illustrator, and Mizuki, the video editor...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we also have a songwriter and a lyricist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, but the lyricist is also able to write her own songs from scratch too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I had no idea!
That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, it really is...
But she's kind of a pain.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right out with it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You just don't get it, Airi. She's an enormous pain to deal with!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Care to expand on that a little?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I just let my mouth run, huh? Maybe I shouldn't have asked that...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's okay, Ena. You don't have to answer if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's just kinda hard to describe... It's a pretty long story, so maybe next time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that works too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, how about I talk about our songwriter instead?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Being able to make illustrations and videos is already very impressive, but I'm always amazed by people who can write their own songs.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah! Her name's K...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: K invited me, Mizuki and our lyricist to form a group called Nightcord at 25:00.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, so she's like the leader then!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sort of, but K doesn't really see it that way.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, K's unbelievably talented when it comes to songwriting. It's like she really knows how to touch your heart through music.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know what you mean! I've seen a few of your guys' videos, but they really do all have that effect.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi told me about one of your songs as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was just a roller coaster of emotions, from feeling somewhat sad in the beginning to having a warm blanket wrapped around me in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes! That's exactly what I'm talking about!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: K has this power to know what you're feeling or trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When I was going through a huge art slump, she ended up composing something just for me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She must be such a nice person...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, she really is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd like to meet this K sometime if I ever get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to as well!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, I hope I do get a chance to introduce you to her. Oh, there's this other girl too. She's a bit of a handful, but you might end up meeting her too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A bit of a handful? You have all this respect for K but not her lyricist?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because she's a pain to deal with.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll understand what I mean if you do ever talk to her. On top of that, she has some pretty serious baggage...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Baggage?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's not really giving me a clear picture.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you seem to enjoy talking about her, Ena. I'm sure she's a good person deep down.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What are you talking about?! I do not enjoy talking about her...!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As much as I'm interested in her friends, we should introduce her to Minori and Haruka at some point as well.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That makes four per group... Wow, eight when you put us all together...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We've come a long way since having only each other to talk to...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad we both found some people we really care about. It'd be fun to just chat without a care in the world with them all.)
